text: The pain is right in the center of my chest, feeling like a heavy weight squeezing it. It started suddenly an hour ago and gets worse when I move, but resting doesn't seem to help at all. speaker: Doctor

speaker: Measurement

text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Inferior Myocardial Infarction secondary to Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy. Despite your history of HCM, the ST elevations in II, III, and aVF confirm an acute heart attack; please proceed immediately to the catheterization lab.
